common_columns.id: bigint identity; transport canonical positive decimal text without Number conversion
common_columns.recorded_at: timestamptz observation/storage time, never inferred native validity
common_columns.tenant_FK: Every local relationship includes workspace_id, installation_id and generation; bare id FK alone is insufficient
common_columns.provider_scope: When applicable: provider/account/connection id+version/reporting selection epoch and credential reference, never credential content; Shopify independent rows have no invented ad connection
common_columns.query_time: Extraction UTC window, business date/timezone and native attribution time basis are different fields/states; do not infer one from another

tables.name: evidence.source_batches
tables.purpose: Bound a source read and durable write outcome to actual owner/attempt; not a provider-atomic snapshot.
unique: same operation identity with different request_digest is conflict, never overwrite
tables.rule: Commit receipt fields and accepted structured versions change in one bounded transaction. A committed partial source remains partial and never advances a complete-range marker.

tables.name: evidence.source_pages
tables.purpose: Store bounded sanitized request-description/response evidence under a purpose-specific encrypted envelope in PostgreSQL.
unique: same page slot plus different payload is conflict
tables.rule: Only query-approved fields enter encrypted payload. No Authorization/cookie/token, signed next URL, profile PII or arbitrary provider error body. Hash refers to the sanitized payload, not an unretained original HTTP body.

tables.name: evidence.source_references
tables.purpose: Typed page and record locators; local row index is valid only with its exact page/batch/hash.
tables.rule: Reference alone is not native identity/claim proof. Unknown IDs stay in evidence without invented canonical records.

tables.name: identity.source_rule_versions
tables.purpose: Version already reviewed integration/source-format rules, not guessed formats or user-entered manual mappings.
columns: applicability jsonb with explicit unknown validity
tables.rule: No production rule is registered by accepting this design. Google/Meta source context and Klaviyo documented integration rules remain provider-specific.

tables.name: identity.product_identity_mappings
tables.label_tr: Platform ürünü ile Shopify ürünü eşlemesi
tables.purpose: Mapping component of the existing five-table proposal, not a second mapping registry.
tables.rule: Canonical identity includes provider/account/catalog-feed-language-native context with explicit missing/null states. Verify canonical tuple as well as hash; no SKU/name/price join. Verified requires Product GID and proven Variant parent when present. No native identity means evidence-only, not a guessed mapping key. Lock the scoped hash, compare canonical tuple and serialization version against every prior identity using that hash, and reject a hash collision; unique hash is not identity proof. Serialization is versioned, sorted-key UTF-8 with explicit null/missing/type markers and no numeric ID coercion.

tables.name: source.shopify_order_versions
tables.purpose: Separate native Order observations and versions; not a provider-attributed fact.
columns: source_money jsonb exact decimal strings+both currencies
tables.rule: Same native version and same hash is replay. Same version with different content is conflict, never last-write-wins. Preserve observed original/current/refunded totals without defining a new net-sales or refund calculation.

tables.name: source.shopify_line_versions
tables.purpose: One native line belongs to an exact observed Order version.
tables.rule: Product/Variant is not the line dedup key. Missing/deleted product does not erase an observed line. No new refund-line query.

tables.name: source.shopify_journey_versions
tables.purpose: Retain current summary and bounded moment-page observations separately from sales and provider claims.
columns: payload_projection jsonb existing safe visit fields only
tables.rule: Pending/null/empty/missing and sales-page completeness remain distinct. Only existing id/time/source/sourceDescription/sourceType; UTM/referrer/landing/MarketingEvent additions deferred to Overlap.

tables.name: source.provider_claim_versions
tables.label_tr: Platformun sipariş veya satış atıf iddiası
tables.purpose: Retain only actually readable typed native claims, separately from Shopify sales and visits.
tables.rule: No Google/Meta claim fabricated from uploads, success receipts, aggregate totals, amount/date proximity or Shopify journey. Preserve unlinked readable claim as unlinked. No new overlap calculator, reattribution or Sales Role.

tables.name: evidence.source_reference_links
tables.label_tr: Bir kaydın birden fazla kanıta bağlantısı
tables.purpose: Many-to-many evidence links with concrete scoped foreign keys instead of unchecked polymorphic target strings.
indexes: scoped FK index for reference and each nonnull target
tables.rule: Exactly one target FK is nonnull; at least one evidence link is required for committed rule/mapping/journey. Source references must belong to either this committing batch or an already committed batch, with exact owner/context/version/hash validation. Reuse of an existing structured native version after a fresh read records a new evidence link only after identical native identity/version/content is proved; arbitrary cross-batch imports are rejected.

payload_allocation.input: Google/Meta/Klaviyo native performance/conversion/product rows and account/time/currency metadata
payload_allocation.later: General canonical PD/CPD facts and FX writer at23; retain native quantity/value variants and support states.

payload_allocation.input: Google/Meta reviewed source rules and verified Shopify candidate observations; Klaviyo product/variant integration observations
payload_allocation.later: Missing real source proof remains unresolved; no production rule manufactured by storage.

payload_allocation.input: Existing Shopify order headers and line pages
payload_allocation.later: Accounting formulas and additional refund extraction not introduced.
Native absence stays unknown; exact overlap implementation remains later.

security.schemas: Private proposed schemas evidence, identity, source; names await owner table approval, not provisioned.
security.roles: Reuse existing owner/coordinator/runtime separation. Browser/Data API public/anon/authenticated/service_role receive no new table access; runtime no direct DML or arbitrary decrypt endpoint.
security.RLS: ENABLE and FORCE RLS plus scoped internal SQL functions. Server-resolved installation/account/selection/deletion authority is verified inside transaction; no caller-set GUC or user_metadata authority.
security.crypto: Purpose-specific AES-256-GCM envelope with key version, fresh nonce and AAD binding owner/batch/page/schema/hash. Separate key namespace and material from token/session encryption; existing token cipher rejects this purpose and is not called unchanged. Proposed nonce12 bytes, authentication tag16 bytes and256-bit independent key material; no key material enters database rows.
security.keys: No key generation, environment variable or provider config change in this design. Key provisioning/rotation and backup-key restore proof precede live storage.
security.minimization: Versioned per-family allowlist preserves relevant native evidence before business interpretation. Disallowed fields are removed before encryption; no full wire dump. Unknown unsafe/schema fields block accepted capture; no silent guessed projection. Mark capture layer and field coverage explicitly: a collector projection cannot prove an omitted field was absent from the native response. Native decimal strings remain unchanged; JSON numeric tokens need lossless capture for exact fidelity. Existing decoded Number values cannot be reconstructed as exact wire values and are labeled decoded_only.
security.decryption: Authenticated bounded internal evidence reader verifies AAD/hash/owner/manifest/expiry before parsing. Normal reporting DTO does not carry ciphertext, raw body or cursor.

lifecycle.replay: Within the same source operation, identical digest returns recorded receipt read-only; different digest conflicts. Across reads, exact native version/content resolves to same structured identity but new page observation may exist. Re-observed unchanged native Order/LineItem versions may reference the original immutable structured rows after exact content/owner verification; the fresh batch retains its own source pages and explicit links. Manifest distinguishes inserted versus reused rows; source observations are not summed as independent sales.
lifecycle.mapping_history: Append immutable revisions; no catalog-format guess, no retroactive native valid-from inferred from verified_at. Existing fact consumers pin an exact mapping/rule version; later mapping cannot rewrite older report identity automatically.
lifecycle.current_selection: Only current accepted revision in exact active owner/connection/account context is eligible; conflicting/withdrawn revision supplies no verified mapping.
lifecycle.disconnect: Existing revoke protocol unchanged. Stop new use; retain historical source rows under existing privacy/retention policy; do not cascade-delete history merely on Disconnect.
lifecycle.reconnect: New connection version or installation generation cannot automatically activate old mappings/rules/pages. Same native product ID with new authority requires fresh validation; historical rows stay separately scoped.
lifecycle.deletion: Attach all10 tables and ciphertext/key references to existing durable privacy manifest/worker in implementation; existing confirmed deletion and shop-redact behavior wins over append-only history. No new deletion scheduler.
lifecycle.expiry: Every batch/page requires finite policy-versioned expiry from an approved class policy before live storage. No arbitrary forever or invented fixed-day retention is selected by this table proposal. Policy owner/expiry/capacity are activation settings, not a new source query.
lifecycle.expiry_effect: Expired payload is removed/tombstoned by existing controlled cleanup path; proof availability becomes expired. Do not silently claim retained proof or delete still-required content via FK cascade. Referenced retention and nonpersonal tombstones must be explicitly covered by the class policy. Proof-dependent current mapping/rule use is blocked when required evidence expires until fresh evidence is verified; historical observation is not silently relabeled currently verified.
lifecycle.restore: Existing deletion-ledger replay precedes service; do not restore deleted payloads or expired keys into active reads.

write_read_protocol.staging: Existing authentic observation, source family and ownership checks precede a bounded stage write. Page capture is not complete-source proof. New capture hooks/DB functions will be separately implemented after this design is accepted.
write_read_protocol.transaction: Recheck current installation/deletion and provider version/selection/fence under existing consistent lock order. Insert or verify pages/references, rule/mapping/source versions and links; validate manifest; mark batch committed and store commit receipt atomically. Roll back all accepted rows on failure.
write_read_protocol.readback: Return commit_id, manifest_hash, owner and counts from same transaction, then bounded receipt/readback reconciles exact operation and bytes. Verify encrypted evidence independently when used.
write_read_protocol.unknown: Lost write acknowledgement stops; do not repeat write or fetch native pages automatically. Explicit read-only receipt inspection: present exact digest proves recorded commit; absent does not prove rollback or termination.
write_read_protocol.partial: Keep successfully staged prefix evidence classified incomplete, never publishable. Existing capacity/fence holds are not released by storage receipt alone. Continuation requires explicit current authority and complete proven next-state; no replay of failed/unknown outbound calls.
write_read_protocol.checkpoint: Source-batch commit and its local completion manifest are Step15. General Dataset commit/checkpoint/FX is Step23. Do not mutate existing job completed marker or accounting checkpoint ahead of its downstream durable handoff.
write_read_protocol.bounds: Explicit per-page/per-batch row/byte/time/transaction/retention budgets and indexed bounded paging required; values come from existing measured capacity gate before live activation, not unlimited JSON blobs or new guessed defaults.

alternatives.rejected_reason: Opaque identity relationships and no typed parent/claim constraints; structured reporting would require scanning/decrypting all pages.

alternatives.option: Encrypted object storage plus DB references
alternatives.deferred_reason: Introduces second commit/deletion/orphan boundary; bounded PostgreSQL ciphertext is initial proposal. Revisit only if measured payload volume cannot meet budgets.

alternatives.not_selected_reason: Six extra link tables instead of one typed nullable-FK association. Revisit if query-plan/constraint evidence favors them; count would change explicitly.

acceptance_cases: same operation replay yields same receipt and no duplicate line/sale
credential/version/selection changes before commit reject write
same Shopify native version with different body remains conflict
missing/deleted product preserves line and evidence
missing journey differs from zero visits; partial sales/journey not complete
verified mapping requires real native rule+same-shop Product/Variant evidence
unknown namespace stays unresolved; no heuristic claim or overlap
tampered ciphertext/AAD/hash/key version rejected without logging body
mid-transaction failure leaves no accepted structured subset
commit reply lost then explicit read-only receipt inspection, no automatic write replay
partial source prefix retained with incomplete manifest and no premature capacity release
Disconnect preserves permitted history but reconnect does not reuse active authority
deletion worker removes all affected records/links/payload, restore replays deletion ledger
expiry exposes proof-unavailable rather than pretending evidence retained
bounded query-plan/byte/memory/connection acceptance under actual profile
delivery_sequence: Owner reviews10-table layout and relationships; no DDL in this proposal
After acceptance prepare repository migration/private writer/readback and focused failure/tenant/crypto tests; keep live apply separate
Wire only approved source capture and structured identity/Order storage; no extra query fields or Step23 writer
Separate native evidence/capacity/security/retention/key/deletion acceptance before live activation

official_sources.limit: Documentation supports mechanisms, not AdsTable model acceptance or live database version/capacity. Changelog retrieved as a read-only HTTPS document after the browser content-type limitation; relevant breaking changes reviewed. No legacy pgcrypto cipher, custom operator or hosted API TLS configuration used or modified.

implementation.capability: Owner-only SQL functions. No runtime/coordinator EXECUTE or schema grants, no route/worker/provider capture activation. Trusted native producer adapters and scoped integration grants remain separate readiness work within Step15.
implementation.retention: Class-specific explicit finite dates; expiry alone never purges. Pending downstream handoff, incomplete source or transitive longer-lived dependency holds ciphertext. No automatic handoff acceptance, no new reporting checkpoint.
implementation.privacy: Existing whole-install deletion worker extended with exact per-table counts. A customer-scoped request with source records is fail-closed, not falsely no_customer_data. Customer association/disclosure handling remains a required pre-live gate; no broad deletion of unrelated customer data is invented.
implementation.testing: Node failure/crypto/owner tests plus real two-pass isolated F01 PostgreSQL source probe, not live data acceptance.
implementation.capture: Internal already-sanitized projection storage boundary; generic bundle is not a native proof. No native capture hook or new query registered.
implementation.deferred: No source fact/FX writer, overlap calculator, added refund/visit fields, new keys/config/live DB apply.

customer_source_privacy.owner_approval: Owner explicitly accepted the concrete next package: customer-scoped source discovery/disclosure/redaction within the existing privacy engine, repository code/SQL/tests/PR, no new provider query or live action. Source: Onerini kabul ediyorum Codex on2026-11-02.
customer_source_privacy.scope: Verified webhook order list preserved only by explicit internal composition. Missing scope distinct from empty; no customer profile/contact stored. No new physical tables. Existing claims/runs/manifests retain authority.
customer_source_privacy.source_processing: Owner-only bounded installation/generation snapshot; decrypt verified envelopes, use exact Order ID/native reference/link evidence. Mixed-page record locators remain stable; only requested records are replaced with null and encrypted again. Other subjects retain exact row hashes and source numeric strings. Unknown subject, unavailable required proof, unsupported locator/family or a shared cross-subject dependency stops without mutation.
customer_source_privacy.redaction: One current-snapshot CAS transaction: resealed pages, related structured rows and references removed together; dependencies retained or rejected, stale mapping proof invalidated. Affected batch is explicitly invalidated and cannot masquerade as the original complete commit. Exact redacted Order IDs are tombstones against re-ingestion in the same installation generation. Whole-install deletion remains existing worker behavior.
customer_source_privacy.disclosure: Only requested source/structured records become an internal bounded artifact. No browser export/email/transport added. Data request remains open without explicit durable external delivery receipt; no false no_customer_data receipt. Actual delivery channel and receipt authority are pre-live acceptance, not automatically created by preparation.
customer_source_privacy.limits: No source-rule/product canonical promotion, no accepted claim join or Overlap. Existing default webhook ingress and SQL queue remain unchanged until separately approved internal sourcePrivacy composition, grants/key/policy and activation. Existing fail-closed historical missing-scope behavior remains. Shared/ambiguous associations require explicit resolution; no broad deletion.
customer_source_privacy.unknown: Prepared capability is private and one-use; a lost write reply is WRITE_UNCONFIRMED and cannot be replayed. Historical existing manifest inspection is separate. Restore must replay retained privacy ledger before service opens; no backup/restore activation in this package.
customer_source_privacy.native_reference_limit: Only exact Shopify Order GID or an already verified same-order FK can identify a claim subject. Bare numeric/custom Klaviyo OrderId is not converted into a Shopify Order ID; it holds fulfillment until its namespace is proven. No new source rule or query is inferred.
